genesisOnlyCoverage.reason: Only genesis is resealed, so sealedArchiveVerifyGenesisLinksV8 observes genesis OriginalV1 unequal to the unchanged intent core before reconstruction.

realChainHelper.name: sealedArchiveReplaceClaimedOriginalV1V8
stepsVerified: decode real meta, intent, all candidates and genesis
derive Kref and Kseal through sealedArchiveKeys
rebuild and reseal intent through sealedArchiveMakeIntentV8
rebuild, reseal and rename every candidate through sealedArchiveMakeCandidateV8 and sealedArchiveContentName
rebuild ordinal candidate links from new candidate references
synchronize genesis migration ID, epoch, intent reference, links and OriginalV1 claim
rebuild, reseal and rename genesis through sealedArchiveMakeGenesisV8 and sealedArchiveContentName

proof: The rebuilt intent passes sealedArchiveVerifyIntentV8 because its core-derived migration ID and epoch are recomputed and its envelope is resealed.
Every candidate carries the new migration ID and epoch, has a new valid reference/seal and matching basename.
Genesis carries the same new IDs, the rebuilt intent reference, all new ordinal candidate links and the same mutated OriginalV1 claim as intent; its envelope and basename are rebuilt.
The reconstructed store state and candidate contents remain unchanged, so storeValidate and storeEncode produce the original real bytes.
The synchronized false claim therefore differs from reconstructed length or SHA256 at sealed_archive_a0.go:543-545 and returns ReconstructionFailed.
Receipt decoding starts later at sealed_archive_a0.go:555, so unchanged receipt bytes cannot preempt the targeted failure.
